***[[Israel]] intercepts a [[ballistic missile]] fired by the [[Houthi]]s from [[Yemen]] that targeted the [[Ben Gurion International Airport]] in [[Tel Aviv]]. [https://www.cnn.com/2025/03/19/middleeast/israel-houthi-missile-yemen-intl-hnk/index.html (CNN)]
*[[Kivu conflict]]
**[[M23 campaign (2022–present)|M23 campaign]]
***[[2025 Walikale offensive]]
****[[Rwanda]]n-backed [[March 23 Movement|M23 rebels]] capture the town of [[Walikale]] in [[North Kivu]], [[Democratic Republic of the Congo]], following the collapse of peace talks with the [[Government of the Democratic Republic of the Congo|Congolese government]]. [https://apnews.com/article/congo-m23-walikale-rwanda-9b0be4acf33ef42b0c7b5d1dcfa9a6c5 (AP)]

**[[Attacks in Russia during the Russian invasion of Ukraine]]
***Massive explosions are reported after the [[Ukrainian Armed Forces]] [[Drone warfare|drone strike]] the [[Engels-2 air base]] in [[Russia]]. Reports indicate that nearby houses are also damaged by the explosions. [https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/ukraine-attacked-airfield-near-engels-strategic-bomber-base-russian-officials-2025-03-20/ (Reuters)]
**[[Odesa strikes (2022–present)|Odesa strikes]]

'''Business and economy'''
*[[German economic crisis (2022–present)|German economic crisis]]
**[[Deutsche Bank]], a [[Germany|German]] multinational [[investment bank]] and [[financial services]] company, announces it will downsize and cut 2,000 jobs in its [[retail banking]] division this year. [https://www.dw.com/en/deutsche-bank-to-slash-2000-jobs/a-71980419 (DW)]

'''International relations'''
*[[Germany–Syria relations]]
**[[Germany]] reopens its [[List of diplomatic missions of Germany|embassy]] in [[Damascus]], [[Syria]] after 13 years. [https://www.euronews.com/my-europe/2025/03/20/germany-reopens-damascus-embassy-13-years-after-syrian-war-forced-its-closure (Euronews)]

'''Law and crime'''
*[[2025 Turkish anti-government protests]], [[Internet regulation in Turkey]]
**The [[67th cabinet of Turkey|Turkish government]] arrests dozens of civilians for posting "provocative" [[social media]] posts protesting the government's [[democratic backsliding]] following the [[Arrest of Ekrem İmamoğlu|arrest]] of opposition candidate [[Ekrem İmamoğlu]]. [https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/cpv43dd3vlgo (BBC)]
*The [[Indonesia]]n [[House of Representatives (Indonesia)|House of Representatives]] passes a law revision regarding the [[Indonesian Armed Forces|armed forces]], which expands the amount of civilian positions an active officer can hold from ten to fourteen while also raising the [[retirement age]] for soldiers, prompting protests across the country fearing eroding [[civil control of the military|civil control]]. [https://www.tempo.co/politik/breaking-news-dpr-sahkan-ruu-tni-1221991 (''Tempo'')] [https://www.cnnindonesia.com/nasional/20250320074411-32-1210920/dpr-resmi-sahkan-ruu-tni-jadi-undang-undang (CNN Indonesia)]
*Social media company [[Twitter|X]] files a lawsuit against the [[government of India]] alleging that the Indian government is [[Censorship in India|censoring]] the social media platform along with other information. [https://www.dw.com/en/india-musks-x-sues-modis-government-in-censorship-battle/a-71989202 (DW)]

'''Politics and elections'''
*[[Second Trump presidency]]
**[[Response to the Department of Government Efficiency]]
***[[United States federal judge|United States district judge]] for the [[United States District Court for the District of Maryland|District of Maryland]] [[Ellen Lipton Hollander]] temporarily blocks the [[Department of Government Efficiency]] from accessing [[Social Security (United States)|Social Security]] systems that cover the [[personal information]] of [[U.S. citizens]]. Judge Hollander also orders the department to delete any previously accessed personal identifiable information in their possession. [https://apnews.com/article/social-security-trump-administration-acfdd0d7a53b7e5a1b5105baa456c5d0 (AP)]
**[[U.S. President]] [[Donald Trump]] signs an [[executive order]] that orders [[United States Secretary of Education|Secretary of Education]] [[Linda McMahon]] to start dismantling the U.S. [[Department of Education (United States)|Department of Education]], which is responsible for allocating [[federal funds]] to schools and disbursing [[Student financial aid|financial aid]]. [https://www.nbcnews.com/politics/white-house/trump-signs-executive-order-dismantle-education-department-white-house-rcna197251 (NBC News)] [https://www.npr.org/2025/03/19/nx-s1-5333861/trump-executive-action-education-department (NPR)]
*[[Vitold Fokin]], the first [[Prime Minister of Ukraine|prime minister]] of [[Ukraine|modern-day Ukraine]], dies at age 92. President [[Volodymyr Zelenskyy]] mourns him as "a sense of loss for all [[Ukrainians]]". [https://kyivindependent.com/ukraines-first-prime-minister-vitold-fokin-dies/ (''The Kyiv Independent'')]

'''Science and technology'''
*The U.S. [[National Highway Traffic Safety Administration]] orders a [[product recall]] of 46,000 [[Tesla Inc.|Tesla]] [[Tesla Cybertruck#Safety concerns|Cybertrucks]], nearly all active Cybertrucks on the roads, due to an issue with an exterior panel that can detach while driving due to an ineffective [[Adhesive bonding in structural steel applications|structural adhesive]]. [https://apnews.com/article/cybertruck-recall-tesla-elon-musk-nhtsa-8c517e21aa1119d74b9db39f6aca01b7 (AP)] [https://thehill.com/policy/technology/5205976-tesla-recalls-cybertrucks/ (''The Hill'')]

'''Sports'''
*[[144th IOC Session]]
**Zimbabwe's [[Ministry of Youth, Sport, Arts and Recreation (Zimbabwe)|Sports Minister]] [[Kirsty Coventry]] is elected as the 10th and first female [[President of the International Olympic Committee]] in the first round of voting. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/sport/olympics/articles/cy4v91e3e1wo (BBC)]
**The [[International Olympic Committee]] votes unanimously to include [[Boxing at the Summer Olympics|boxing]] in the [[2028 Summer Olympics]]. [https://www.bbc.com/sport/olympics/articles/cqx01qx9ll2o (BBC News)]
